name: Yoshie Matsuri
source: Senior student and older sister of Izumi. Is best friends with Kamine though is often teased by her. Is self conscious of her weight often trying new diet fads and failing which leads to others teasing her more.
translation: 三年级学生，也是泉的姐姐。她是香峰的挚友，却经常被香峰捉弄。她很在意自己的体重，总是尝试新的减肥潮流，却屡屡失败，结果被别人更加频繁地捉弄。
